notes: New optional look: Anime Pixel! Open Settings and tap "Art style" to switch between Classic (still the default) and the new HD pixel-art style. Your choice is saved

All 9 heroes are redrawn with new idle, walk, attack, jump and hurt animations: Rogue, Warlock, Summoner, Ranger, Reaper, Rift Dancer, Druid, Mage and Eclipse Paragon. Your outfit, armour set and race still change how they look
The Druid's Shadowcat and Elderbark Treant forms get the new look too
All 26 enemy types are redrawn, including every boss, plus the ground, roads, trees, rocks, gems, gold coins and the Wandering Merchant
Spell effects, projectiles and menus keep their classic look for now, and the Shade race keeps its classic hero
In our tests Anime Pixel ran a little faster than Classic, and switching styles never touches your saves
